utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday, 24 April. Are we all on? Teams is doing that thing where half the faces disappear.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'm here. Only just, mind. Traffic on the ring road was ridiculous.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, traffic on the ring road got me as well. Sat looking at the same drain cover for ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Lovely bit of sightseeing, that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'd swap you. The heating in the portakabin is either tropical or completely off. Apparently we've gone tropical this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ah, the luxury office package.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Can you hear me? My headset's— hang on. There.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, got you. Right, finished stuff first, then what we're actually agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I tested the line 3 barrel yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished, nothing new off the back of it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Good. That was the one still showing in yesterday's conversation, wasn't it?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I tested the Compressed Air Dryer yesterday and it's all fine now. That test is done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. The sensor recalibration on the Compressed Air Dryer is still separate though, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, different bit. Yesterday was the functional test, not the recalibration.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer this morning? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Compressed Air Dryer this morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Normal priority, this morning. Not reopening yesterday's test.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly, yeah. Two separate things.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, what about the seals on the main water valve?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'll replace the seals on the main water valve. It's not an emergency but don't let it slip, that one. I'll take it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marcus. Agreed, that's yours.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, not a drop-everything job, but not one to quietly forget either.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Just on water, I noticed the Site Water System was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Just an observation, not raising another job.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Same sort of thing: noticed the turbine one gas valve was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Nothing outstanding from that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, both observations only. Not adding those as actions.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And still waiting on parts for the Air Compressor 1, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. That's still blocked, not something we're committing to do today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep. No change there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya Raman, can you do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet by the end of the week? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I haven't got the capacity to take that. Don't put it against me and assume it's covered.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sarah, could you take the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet instead, then? Same end-of-week deadline, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, I'll take them. I'll do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet by the end of the week. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And pre-use is still pre-use, obviously. End of the week isn't permission to use anything unchecked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Absolutely. It's Friday today anyway, but yes, understood. Those checks are mine, not Priya Raman's.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you sort the training records for the new starters this morning? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the training records for the new starters this morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you— no rush, but still this morning?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. No need to drop everything this instant, but this morning is still the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine by me. That's clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you also grease and check the bearings on the feedwater pump? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, I'll grease and check the bearings on the feedwater pump. I'll take that as well.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that wording's about right. Doesn't need the blue lights and sirens.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Not an emergency, but it does need doing. Aisha's got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, could you write up the near miss at the Main Outfeed Conveyor on Friday as well?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, no, sorry. With those two I've just accepted, I can't take the write-up as well. It'll get squeezed out.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Grace, can you take that instead: write up the near miss at the Main Outfeed Conveyor on Friday?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll write up the near miss at the Main Outfeed Conveyor on Friday. Take Aisha off that one; it's mine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And Friday there means today, just so nobody reads it as next Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, today. Grace has accepted that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you investigate the pressure drop on the GT2 water valve for Monday? That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the GT2 water valve, due Monday. Understood, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's separate from the main water valve seals, just to keep the two straight?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes. Mine's the pressure-drop investigation on the GT2 water valve, not the seal replacement.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's also the collection from Kestrel Hydraulics Leeds, the replacement parts for the Boiler Safety Relief Valve. That's still needing someone.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll go to Kestrel Hydraulics Leeds to pick up the replacement parts for the Boiler Safety Relief Valve tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Tomorrow? You've remembered that's Saturday, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I have, sadly. Tomorrow, Saturday the 25th, at 9:30. I'll do the collection.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, Sarah for that. Tomorrow at 9:30, understood.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: One gap, though. The risk assessment for work on the Injection Moulding Line 3 needs updating. That's not done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to take updating the risk assessment for work on the Injection Moulding Line 3?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I can't take that on with the records and the near-miss write-up. Raising the gap, not volunteering, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I can't pick it up either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Nobody's taking that one. It remains unallocated; let's not make it look covered when it isn't.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And the line 3 barrel test being finished doesn't mean that risk assessment's sorted. Different thing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quite. Test done, risk assessment update still needs an owner. No commitment on that today.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Nothing else from me. And you can still hear me, so that's a personal best for Teams.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Don't say that out loud. It'll hear you.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: At least if it cuts out, I'll still have the sound of this heater attempting take-off.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, we'll leave it there. Thanks, everyone. Cheers.
